sources.claim: Defines machine-readable dataset, record-set, file, field, provenance, use-policy and distribution metadata with stable references and checksums.

sources.claim: Separates dataset, distribution, data service, catalog record and dataset series, and specifies version, checksum, rights and lifecycle relations.

sources.claim: Distinguishes assets, parties, permissions, prohibitions, duties, constraints, policy profiles and conflict strategies for machine-readable use conditions.
sources.scope_limit: A policy expression is not proof of legal validity, consent, entitlement, enforcement or fulfilled duty.

sources.claim: Defines core identity, creators, publisher, dates, versions, resource types and typed related identifiers for citation and retrieval.
sources.scope_limit: Citation metadata neither proves dataset contents nor replaces an immutable membership manifest.

sources.claim: Documents composable dynamic filtering, slicing, matching, sorting, selection and saved views over heterogeneous dataset samples.
sources.scope_limit: One provider's view API is not the portable membership algebra and a view is not a released dataset edition.

sources.claim: Documents immutable read-only dataset snapshots, mutable HEAD, captured and excluded state, archival and restoration semantics.
sources.scope_limit: Snapshot mechanics do not prove curation quality, external media immutability, rights or publication readiness.
sources.title: Dataset Versioning

sources.claim: Documents export of whole datasets or selected views, media/labels independently, into multiple formats.
sources.scope_limit: Serialization/export is a delivery mechanism, not proof of semantic equivalence or release authorization.

sources.claim: Dataset repositories carry files, revision history, public/private access, structured formats, viewers and documentation.
sources.scope_limit: Repository packaging does not establish dataset fitness, rights, contamination freedom or independent product conformance.

sources.claim: Documents dataset content, context, responsible use, bias, license, language, modality, size, source and task metadata.
sources.scope_limit: A card can be incomplete or inaccurate and is not a conformance or acceptance receipt.

sources.claim: Shows that exact and near duplication and train-test overlap are separate measurable dataset risks with distribution and memorization consequences.
sources.scope_limit: Text-corpus results do not universalize thresholds, similarity representations, removal policy or effects across modalities and uses.

sources.claim: ImageJ documents reusable scripts and macros applied across image sets.
sources.scope_limit: Automation mechanics do not define scientific fitness, image identity or downstream authority.

sources.claim: ImageJ distinguishes reusable regions of interest and ROI-associated measurements.
sources.scope_limit: One tool's ROI representation is not a portable region/object algebra.

sources.claim: A project binds an image file list, metadata, channel/group relations and an analysis pipeline.
sources.scope_limit: A project container does not prove input validity or result fitness.

sources.claim: Sequential modules, settings, test mode, batch execution and explicit output modules form a reproducible analysis workflow.
sources.scope_limit: Sequential provider modules are evidence for a lifecycle, not the universal recipe algebra.

sources.claim: Measurements are attached to images or objects produced by prior modules and can be viewed or exported.
sources.scope_limit: A produced measurement is not accepted scientific truth or a business decision.
sources.title: Measurement modules

sources.claim: QuPath projects manage collections of images and associated analysis data.
sources.scope_limit: A pathology-oriented implementation cannot own the cross-domain product semantics.

sources.claim: QuPath distinguishes annotations, detections and regions used for measurements and scoped analysis.
sources.scope_limit: Annotation and detection objects do not acquire reference, diagnosis or inspection authority.

sources.claim: Recorded workflows can be converted into scripts and applied across projects.
sources.scope_limit: Recorded commands do not by themselves guarantee deterministic replay or semantic compatibility.

sources.claim: QuPath exposes object measurement tables, maps and project-level exports.
sources.scope_limit: Exported tables do not prove units, uncertainty, validity or downstream acceptance.
sources.title: Commands and measurement export

sources.scope_limit: Viewer layer types do not establish source truth, reference acceptance or analytical correctness.

sources.claim: Layer transforms, axis labels and units connect data coordinates to displayed world coordinates.
sources.scope_limit: Rendering transforms are not automatically calibrated physical-coordinate evidence.
sources.title: Scale and unit-aware rendering

sources.scope_limit: Microscopy metadata does not define a universal analysis project or scientific conclusion.
sources.title: OME Data Model and File Formats

sources.scope_limit: Carrier/interchange semantics do not own workbench lifecycle, method fitness or result acceptance.
